entries.title: Blood West
entries.definitive_edition: Blood West: Gold Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with current updates and DLC.

primary.why: The Windows PC Gold Edition is the best archive route because it includes the base game, Dead Man's Promise story DLC, Scavengers roguelite DLC, and soundtrack while keeping native PC settings/capture flexibility; PS5 and Xbox Series X/S have the same sourced DLC route but no exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Blood West: Gold Edition on Steam or GOG for Windows PC to get the base game plus Dead Man's Promise, Scavengers, and the soundtrack.

entries.remaster_caveats: Dead Man's Promise and Scavengers are DLC; Gold Edition is a bundle/complete edition rather than a remaster. Nintendo Switch 2 rating rumors are not counted as a release without a public storefront release.
